prerequisites.text: Hold an active Nevada hunting or combination license (or buy one while applying) to earn a bonus point. If you choose to buy the license only if drawn, you get no bonus point when unsuccessful.
prerequisites.quote: An active hunting or combination license is required in order to obtain a bonus point.

prerequisites.text: A hunting license is required before a big game tag can be issued; big game also needs a tag.
prerequisites.quote: Big game hunting requires a tag in addition to a hunting license.

prerequisites.text: A valid hunter education certificate must be attached to your account to buy a hunting license.
prerequisites.quote: A valid hunter education certificate attached to a customer's account is needed to purchase a hunting license.

prerequisites.text: Apply online only at ndowlicensing.com; mailed applications are not accepted. A Social Security number is required.
prerequisites.quote: must be submitted through the internet at www.ndowlicensing.com. Applications submitted by mail for these species will not be accepted.

prerequisites.text: Pay for awarded tags within 7 days of the draw, or the tag can go to an alternate.
prerequisites.quote: Successfully awarded tag and permit applicants will have seven (7) days after the draw finalizations to complete the payment of the tag or permit.

notes: Nevada has not posted 2027 big-game draw dates (checked 2026-11-04). Commission Regulation CR 26-01 covers the 2026 big-game draws and only the 2027 spring turkey draw, so all big-game dates above are from 2026, marked last_year. A 2027 regulation (CR 27-01) would normally be adopted in January. The opening dates (Feb. 9, March 23, June 8) come from the 2026 calendar on the NDOW Apply & Buy page; deadlines, times and results dates come from CR 26-01. Conflict: the web calendar lists the second-draw deadline as June 15, while CR 26-01 says 'Monday, June 16, 2026'. June 16, 2026 was a Tuesday and June 15 was the Monday, so June 15 is recorded, with the 11 p.m. PT time from the regulation. Treat the second-draw deadline as uncertain. Fees come from the NDOW web page and NRS 502.240/502.250 (set by statute; no year printed, recorded as 2026). Bonus points are squared in the draw, and you lose them if you skip two consecutive years in a category. About 90% of tags go to residents and 10% to nonresidents. Bear tags are in the main draw but outside this file's scope.
